messages:
From: Sophie Dalton <sophie@apexware.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ownership transfer & go-live timeline for ApexWare integration

Hi Priya / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Procurement attached the signed SOW (Signed-SOW-ApexWare.pdf). We want to align on how the ownership transfer from sales to CS/implementation will look, and lock a tentative go-live window so our IT team can reserve resources.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm target start date for the implementation sprint (we're aiming for mid-Oct).
- Identify the technical lead at Redwood who will be the day-to-day contact for API/network onboarding.
- Share a short milestone timeline (key dates + who owns each).

Procurement will loop in a billing contact separately, but for now here's my availability for a 30-min sync: Thu 9/10 10–11am PT or Fri 9/11 2–4pm PT.

Sophie
Sophie Dalton
Head of Product Partnerships | ApexWare
Sophie.Dalton@apexware.com

To: Sophie Dalton <sophie@apexware.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 13:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Ownership transfer & go-live timeline for ApexWare integration

Hi Sophie — great to have the SOW, thanks. Welcome aboard! I’ll be your CS lead through the onboarding and will coordinate the delivery slate. Quick notes and a proposed starter plan below.

Proposed kickoff & milestones (tentative):
- Oct 11 — Project kickoff (intro call, SSO/API access kickoff) — Owner: Priya Natarajan (CS)
- Oct 13–22 — Environment & network setup, firewall allowlist validation — Owner: Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng)
- Oct 25–29 — Initial data sync + smoke tests — Owner: Marissa Cole
- Nov 1–5 — Acceptance testing + user training session 1 — Owner: Priya Natarajan
- Nov 8 — Go/no-go decision and production cutover (target) — Owner: Ben Carter (Ops Lead)

A few asks for your team before kickoff:
- IT contact for firewall/IP allowlist testing (name + best email)
- Test account list (3 users) for training and acceptance
- Any blackout dates in Oct/Nov we should avoid for cutover

I can block Thu 9/10 10:30am PT for a 30-min sync if that works for you — will send a calendar invite. I’ll attach a short implementation checklist after this email.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0182
Attachment: Redwood-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com, Sophie Dalton <sophie@apexware.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Ownership transfer & go-live timeline for ApexWare integration

Thanks Priya — looping in some technical detail so the timeline is actionable.

Hi Sophie — brief technical plan and owners below. I’ll take primary ownership for the integration track and will escalate to Ben for infra/ops if we hit performance or environment limits.

Technical milestones & acceptance criteria:
- Network prep (Oct 13–14): verify allowlist and TCP reachability to inference endpoints; acceptance: successful curl to /health endpoint from ApexWare subnet. Owner: Marissa Cole
- API keys & SSO (Oct 15–18): generate scoped API keys + SAML configuration test. Acceptance: SSO login + token-based requests succeed against a staging model. Owner: Marissa Cole
- Data sync (Oct 20–22): sample payloads processed and returned within latency SLOs. Acceptance: 95th percentile token latency < 400ms in staging. Owner: Marissa Cole / Ben Carter
- Training + handover docs (Oct 27–29): run walkthrough and share runbook; acceptance: two training recordings and runbook ack from your admins. Owner: Priya Natarajan

Risks to call out now:
- If ApexWare's security team requires static IP peering vs allowlist, that adds 1–2 weeks; please flag early.
- Large sample payloads (>5MB) may need batching/timeout tuning — we can prototype during the Oct 20–22 window.

I’ll be on the kickoff call if scheduled.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: (none)

From: Sophie Dalton <sophie@apexware.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ApexWare Procurement <procurement@apexware.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ownership transfer & go-live timeline for ApexWare integration

Thanks, Priya and Marissa — this looks good and very clear. Procurement also confirmed billing next week, so no blockers there.

Quick replies to the asks:
- IT contact: Marco Ruiz (marco.ruiz@apexware.com) — he’s copied on a separate thread and will join the kickoff.
- Test accounts: I’ll provide 3 test user emails by EOD Friday 9/11.
- No blackout dates in Oct/Nov right now.

Confirming the kickoff for Oct 11 at 10:00am PT works for us. Please send an invite and attach the implementation checklist/runbook you mentioned. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Sophie
